problem:
$\,$ If you eat your vegetables, then you can have dessert.

Which statement is logically equivalent to the conditional statement above?

choices.value: Eat your vegetables, and you cannot have dessert.
Either you don't eat your vegetables, or you can have dessert.
Either you eat your vegetables, or you cannot have dessert.
Don't eat your vegetables, or you cannot have dessert.
Either you eat your vegetables, or you can have dessert.
